verdict.rationale: Retell ships Conductor, a built-in AI assistant that takes plain-language requests to build and refine agents, run simulation tests, investigate call and chat history, inspect knowledge bases, AI QA results and contacts, and build analytics dashboards. It proposes changes for review before applying them, and the quick-start offers 'Generate from prompt' to draft an agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's delegation quality (all evidence is vendor docs).
